correctness.rationale: The exact orthant-volume formula F_n(a,b)=sum_j binom(n,j)^2 a^(n-j)b^j is reconstructed, reduced to H_n(ab), and related to the classical simple real Legendre zeros to factor H_n as a product with positive coefficients. The reflected polynomial is exactly (s+u)^n product_i(1+r_i(p)su/(s+u)^2). Each factor r_i(p) decreases strictly, making every interior coefficient strictly decrease because its first positive elementary-symmetric contribution has coefficient binom(n-2,k-1)>0. Exact endpoints follow directly. The quadratic coefficient is independently obtained from the hypergeometric variance identity and matches the analytic Taylor expansion. A standalone exact rational verifier passed 1605 checks in dimensions 2..16; these do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The recent resolution of the sharp Godbersen inequality motivates tracing the behavior of all n-1 normalized reflection mixed-volume coefficients while a simplex is continuously symmetrized. The theorem gives strict global coefficientwise order at every interpolation parameter, all equality boundaries and an exact n,k-dependent center stability coefficient; none is supplied by the endpoint Godbersen theorem. The full vector-level structural statement is not a renamed coefficient table or unmotivated finite slice.
